channel.title: Business Insider Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Africa (africa.businessinsider.com)

item.title: US, Mali to reopen security alliance with new drone intelligence deal across the Sahel
item.description: The United States is nearing a new agreement with Mali that would allow American aircraft and drones to resume intelligence gathering flights over the country, according to current and former U.S. officials familiar with the negotiations.

item.title: Top 10 richest people in Africa in 2026, according to latest ranking
item.description: Africa’s billionaire club is getting richer by the year. With stock markets rising and currencies stabilising across the continent, the fortunes of the region’s top business leaders have surged.

item.title: Africa’s largest oil refinery just pushed petrol prices higher as oil surges past $100
item.description: The Dangote Petroleum Refinery has hiked the ex-depot gasoline rates for Premium Motor Spirit (PMS) and Automotive Gas Oil (AGO) to ₦1,175 and ₦1,620, respectively.

item.title: Dangote warns import-dependent countries of rising fuel pressure as tanker costs hit $3.5 million per shipment
item.description: Global fuel markets have been thrown into turmoil since the escalation of conflict in the Middle East, triggering sharp oil price swings and surging shipping costs.

item.title: US government warns of possible terrorist attacks on its embassy, US-affiliated facilities in Nigeria
item.description: The United States government has issued a fresh security advisory for its citizens in Nigeria, warning of potential threats against U.S. facilities and affiliated schools.

item.title: Egyptian billionaire Naguib Sawiris calls Iran’s attacks on UAE a war against freedom and progress
item.description: Egyptian billionaire Naguib Sawiris has condemned Iran’s recent missile and drone attacks on the United Arab Emirates, describing the assault as more than just a military operation.

item.title: Mercedes eyes sharing South Africa factory with China's GWM
item.description: Mercedes-Benz Group AG is exploring the possibility of sharing its South African manufacturing plant with Chinese automaker Great Wall Motor Co., a move that could strengthen the facility amid US trade tariffs.

item.title: BRICS powerhouses Brazil and South Africa explore defence pact amid warnings of foreign threats
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has urged South Africa to deepen defence cooperation with Brazil, warning that emerging economies risk vulnerability to foreign threats if they fail to strengthen their military capabilities.

item.title: DRC’s state gold project targets 15 tons of artisanal gold with central bank backing
item.description: The Democratic Republic of Congo is seeking to significantly increase the volume of gold sourced from its vast artisanal mining sector as part of a broader effort to formalize trade and strengthen national reserves.

item.title: Africa startup funding rebounds to $272m in February but six companies dominate investment
item.description: Startup funding in Africa recovered in February 2026 after a weak start to the year, but most of the money went to only a handful of companies. According to data from Africa: The Big Deal, 40 startups across the continent raised more than $272 million last month through deals worth at least $100,000.
